# with it, and nothing here is in the library for their sake any more.

# For day-to-day setup use scripts/setup.sh (requirements*.txt), because
# tinysoundfont needs --no-deps: pyaudio cannot be installed here (DESIGN.md §9.2)
# and tinysoundfont imports it in exactly one place, Synth.start(), which we do not
# call. `pip install --dry-run` reports success for it anyway, so a dry run is not
# evidence.
#
# It previously also warned about OpenCV: mediapipe required the GUI build, whose Qt
# plugins hijack PySide6's, and both builds write to the same cv2/ directory, so the
# GUI one had to be uninstalled before the headless one was installed (§2.2, §7.2).
# That was the most expensive trap in this file and it needed a strict install
# order. There is no OpenCV here now, and none should ever come back without that
# order being re-established (DESIGN.md §25).
